done_when: live_aid panel shows 2-4 readings with probability + source label, the deciding layer, and prepared confirm/kill per reading; each map is scored in SCENARIO_LEDGER.md; base rates come from a backtest on Binance 1m/5m history (OI, taker delta) with fee-free descriptive stats labelled as such.
goal: Prepare the operator for a live trade: for the current layer state, show every plausible reading of the same data (e.g. price up + OI up = new aggressive longs OR shorts opening into the rally OR other exchanges doing something Binance is not), the probability of each (measured base rate where we have history, else labelled OURS guess), what tells them apart next (the deciding layer), and what to expect and prepare for under each. Shown as a dashboard panel (live_aid.html) and popped as an alert when the leading reading flips.
